name: Gambol Pet Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Gambol Pet Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and global distribution of various pet care products. The company's extensive offerings include nutritional meals specifically formulated for dogs, cats, and other companion animals, in addition to a range of specialized pet snacks and health support supplements. While its primary operations are based in China, Gambol Pet Group also ships its merchandise to international markets including Europe, the United States, Japan, and South Korea. This firm was established in 2006 and operates from its base in Liaocheng, China.
